title: Vedan
desc: Vijay, a police officer, strives to capture a criminal. However, when he infiltrates the gang, he strives to keep his identity secret as well as fulfil his mission.

title: Subash
desc: Subhash, an unemployed young man, joins the army to be able to marry his lover. However, when he returns from his deployment, he is shocked to see his brother leading a corrupt life.

title: En Thangachi Padichava
desc: When a police officer gets transferred to a troubled village terrorised by a wealthy landlord, he seeks the help of an ex-convict to seize the tyrant.

title: Ullam Kollai Poguthae
desc: Anbu, a mimicry artist, falls for his sister's friend Jyothi, who is in love with Gautham. Just when they are about to get married, an accident changes the course of their lives forever.

title: Kovil
desc: Shaktivel and Angel, who belong to rival villages, fall in love with each other. However, as Angel's father is unhappy with her choice of groom, he forces her to become a nun.
